verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents multi-step ad-hoc and template-based workflows with automatic steps, and configurable agents that automate processes. None of the evidence shows a user scheduling those workflows or jobs to run on a recurring time-based schedule. The periodic snapshot feature is a fixed ransomware-recovery capability, not user-defined recurring workflow scheduling, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
